subject: general
question: Which river stretch is known as National Waterways-2?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmaputra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brahmaputra**__ river stretch is known as National Waterways-2.
 
• Between **Bangladesh's border and Sadiya**, the river Brahmaputra runs for 891 kilometres.
 
• On September 1, 1988, it was designated as National Waterway No. 2 (NW-2).
 
• **National Waterway-1 **(Prayagraj-Haldia) is the longest National waterway in India(1620 km).
